text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd get to visit this trendy 
amusement park together with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Did you know? They recently renovated the 
roller coaster and it's been drawing lots 
of attention...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
What I especially want to highlight 
isââthe parade!
choice_data_list:
We could probably use that for event 
planning.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly it! So I wanted to use it 
as reference for work...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...It was strictly for work reference! I 
just wanted to see the parade!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I've already scouted out the best 
viewing spot. Let's head over right away!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew…… It's about to start…… Stay calm, 
stay calm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed somewhat restless. Concerned, I 
was about to call out to her, but――

text_block_list.name: Carrot Queen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you carrot-loads for coming to see 
Carrot Queen☆ Let's dance together, 
carro~♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: What a wonderful parade that was...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Music and lighting synchronized to create 
pure immersion. Choreography taking full 
advantage of the dancers' costume 
materials.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: And above all else――

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Carrot Queen is... so cuteee!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! And that cuteness isn't just 
skin-deep, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Her autograph handwriting is sooo, soooo 
cute! I still have the autograph board she 
gave me when I was a student on display!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because I wanted to see the Carrot 
Queen, I went to watch the parade again 
today—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: *gasp*!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I-I spilled the whole thing... And I was 
trying so hard to keep it a secret...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
B-But it's so embarrassing! Getting so 
carried away that I started rambling like 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh... waaahhh...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Let's keep this our little 
secret.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: If anyone else found out... I-I...
choice_data_list: There's nothing to be ashamed of.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list:
It's wonderful to have something you can 
lose yourself in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The inspiration she felt watching that 
parade is bound to nourish her growth. 
When I shared that thought with her――

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that inspiration back then... That 
feeling of pure adoration might have been 
where it all began.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I see... There's no need to feel 
embarrassed. No, I should actually be 
enjoying it, shouldn't I!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Um! Trainer, won't you hang out with me 
just a bit longer?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: To what I love most!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Eee! So cute! That Carrot Queen ear 
headband looks adorable on you!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Let's definitely buy it! And next up is 
the meet-and-greet you've been waiting 
for!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah! We need to buy signing boards for 
autographs too! And maybe plushies to go 
with them...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying what she loved with all her 
might, she truly shone radiant.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! It's hardly repayment, but I'll 
keep you company next time, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Are there any attractions that caught your 
eye?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, what came to mind... was 
that newly renovated attraction everyone 
had been talking about.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-Y-Y... Yes, indeed! I-I-I'm really 
l-l-looking forward to it!
choice_data_list: Let's skip ――, I'm no good at it!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...You too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no! If you're not good with it, let's 
not!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll keep it a secret. I 
won't tell a soul!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Look at that, we share another 
secret now!
